text:
At the fretted window ledge

of the Moorish casement, pale

as the moon, a lover lingers,

lost in thought.


Pale upon her turtledove-

gray and crimson silken couch,

Eva, silent, plucks a violet

petal by petal into her tea.

translation.title: Simple Verses XVI
translation.editorial_note: The compact scene and its color contrasts take precedence over forcing the original enclosed rhyme.
